verifications.claim: The 98th Academy Awards occurred on March 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '98th Academy Awards in Hollywood on March 15'; R3: 'March 15, 2026... 98th Academy Awards'; R4: '2026 Academy Awards on Sunday (March 15)'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the 98th Oscars were on March 15, 2026.

verifications.claim: A tie occurred in the Best Live Action Short Film category at the 98th Academy Awards.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'best live-action short film resulted in... An Oscar tie... 98th Academy Awards'; R2: 'two films tied for best short live action film'; R3: 'two films... Best Live Action Short... 98th Academy Awards'; R4/R5 similar.
verifications.reasoning: All sources unanimously confirm the tie in Best Live Action Short Film at the 98th Oscars.

verifications.claim: The tie was between "The Singers" (Sam A. Davis and Jack Piatt) and "Two People Exchanging Saliva" (Alexandre Singh and Natalie Musteata).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The Singers... Sam A. Davis and Jack Piatt and Two People Exchanging Saliva... Alexandre Singh and Natalie Musteata'; identical in R2-R5.
verifications.reasoning: All sources exactly match the films and credited individuals.

verifications.claim: The tie marks the seventh tie in Oscar history.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Ties have happened six times previously'; R3: 'the seventh time'; R4: 'only happened 6 other times'; R5: 'the seventh tie'
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently describe this as the seventh tie (six previous).

verifications.claim: Previous ties at the Oscars occurred in 2012, 1994, 1986, 1968, 1949, and 1931/32.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.reasoning: Majority of sources match the listed years exactly, but R2 provides different years for the same events, creating contradiction.
